Maya Chen: Heads-up — hardware partner reported delayed shipment for reserved A800 racks. We have 10 reserved for Dedicated customers in EU. Lead time now 6-9 weeks instead of 2-3. Need to coordinate allocation and comms.
Samir Patel: Which supplier? Any PO numbers or confirmation? We need to know which customer reservations are affected.
Maya Chen: It's via VectorCompute (NVIDIA channel partner). PO VC-4829 — got an email this morning. They flagged a PCB shortage on the A800 line. Offered split delivery but no firm dates for the remainder.
Elaine Park: Ok. Two action items: 1) reroute new Dedicated provisioning to our spare pool in us-west for immediate requests, 2) add a routing policy to favor compatible model variants for low-latency fallbacks. @Rajiv can we spin up temporary capacity on GCP europe-west using the marketplace credits we have?
Rajiv Kapoor: I can provision a short-term burst on GCP using marketplace images. Need finance sign-off for a one-off budget (~$120k/mo) and the reservation ID/tenancy details. Draft terraform snippet for ops: ```resource "redwood_capacity" "temp" { region = "europe-west1" type = "nvidia-t4" count = 12 }```
Samir Patel: For customer comms: propose emailing impacted Dedicated customers with three options — a) delayed delivery with priority queue, b) temporary cross-region failover, or c) one-time credits. I'll coordinate with AE; @Maya can you pull the list of affected subscriptions and priority tiers?
Maya Chen: On it — exporting list now, will share by EOD. I also asked VectorCompute for a split-delivery schedule; they replied partial delivery possible in ~3 weeks but remainder is TBD. I'll push for dates.
CloudOps Bot: Reservation VC-4829 status: UPDATED -> Partial shipment scheduled (eta ~3w). Remaining units: TBA. Details: https://vectorcompute.example/po/VC-4829
Rajiv Kapoor: If partial arrives we should prioritize racks for high-throughput enterprise customers and keep low-priority ones in queue. Need a mapping of rack IDs to subscription priority.
Elaine Park: Also a heads-up for marketing/joint announcements — do NOT make capacity guarantees publicly until procurement stabilizes. Marketing asked if we can continue promoting Dedicated in EU; yes, but remove any language promising immediate capacity. @Samir please coordinate partner notice on marketplace listings.
Samir Patel: I'll draft a partner escalation to VectorCompute requesting firm delivery dates and ask to escalate to their VP of Supply. Scheduling a call tomorrow 10:00am PT to sync. Adding @Maya @Rajiv @Elaine.
Maya Chen: Call confirmed and on my calendar. Agenda: delivery timeline, split-shipment prioritization, escalation contacts, and contingency sizing. Thanks everyone — I'll post the export when ready.
